title: Domestic Gas Stoves — For Use with LPG — Part 1: General Requirements

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 398 (Part 1) specifies general requirements for domestic gas stoves for use with liquefied petroleum gas (LPG). Covers single-burner, double-burner, and multi-burner stoves. Domestic LPG gas stoves are under MANDATORY ISI certification (Scheme I). Every gas stove sold in India must bear the ISI mark.
